info.name: Benchmarks Price Differences Price Feeds API

params.name: query
params.description: If provided, the results will be filtered to all price feeds whose symbol contains the query string. Query string is case insensitive.

params.name: asset_type
params.description: Filter by asset type. Possible values are `crypto`, `equity`, `fx`, `metal`, `rates`. Filter string is case insensitive.

items.docs: Returns the price feed for all symbols or for selected symbols when filters are provided.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the price feed to be returned.

items.docs: Returns the price feed for the given id.
